author: feral-core
description: Generate an image from a text description with an OpenAI GPT image model (gpt-image-1.5 by default; FERAL_IMAGE_MODEL overrides). Needs an OpenAI key, read from the vault entry for 'image_gen' or from the OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable; with neither present every call fails with 'No image generation providers configured (set OPENAI_API_KEY)' and no image is produced. There is no keyless fallback provider.

endpoints.description: Generate an image from a text prompt. The image comes back as base64 PNG bytes in 'b64'. The 'url' field is always null: GPT image models return base64 only, so no hosted URL is ever produced. Do not tell the user you have a link.

params.name: size
params.description: Image size: 1024x1024 (default), 1536x1024 (landscape), 1024x1536 (portrait) or auto. The old DALL-E sizes 1792x1024 and 1024x1792 are mapped to the landscape/portrait sizes; any other value becomes 1024x1024.

params.name: style
params.description: Accepted and ignored. GPT image models take no style parameter; put the desired look in the prompt instead.

params.name: n
params.description: Accepted and then ignored: the skill returns exactly one image per call.

endpoints.returns_description: {b64: base64 PNG bytes, url: always null, revised_prompt: the prompt as the model rendered it (falls back to the input prompt), provider: the model id used, size}
